reasons: The student requires a minimum of 12 MC in any semester with modules. The total MC for the 12 required courses (including added CS1231) is 48 MC. With NOC in Sem 6 (0 MC), there are 7 active semesters. It is mathematically impossible to distribute 48 MC across 7 semesters such that every active semester has at least 12 MC (7 * 12 = 84 MC required). Additionally, ST2334 is fixed in Sem 8, which would only contain 4 MC, violating the 12 MC minimum.
